description: Trigger discrimination for optional pre-implementation design iteration against the nearest owners plus catalog navigation.

cases.prompt: Settings flow is unsettled: compare two or three meaningfully different approaches before building.
cases.reason: Flow comparison before implementation is this skill's core.

cases.prompt: We choose B - explore and refine first; run the bounded loop with a prototype and independent critique.
cases.reason: Explicit explore-and-refine with prototype, review and budget.

cases.prompt: During our recorded design iteration for checkout settings, have an independent reviewer exercise the prototype and check hierarchy, layout, typography, spacing, labels, responsive, focus and keyboard against the design system.
cases.reason: An independent rendered-UI review inside an active iteration record is this skill's review step; design-review-facilitator facilitates a design review meeting instead.

cases.prompt: Cap exploration at three concepts and three passes, then say whether it is ready to build.
cases.reason: Bounded concept/pass budget plus readiness is iteration work.

cases.prompt: Resume the recorded design iteration for profile with the same mode, budget and evidence.
cases.reason: Resuming a recorded iteration belongs to this record.

cases.prompt: Prototype just enough of the save-confirmation interaction, naming mocked and incomplete parts.
cases.reason: Prototype scope plus smallest artifact plus rendered review.

cases.prompt: Record dispositions for the review findings and independently retest the revised candidate.
cases.reason: Disposition plus independent retest before advancing.

cases.prompt: Review this skill draft for trigger quality, collisions and eval coverage.

cases.prompt: Design and later read an A/B test to prove which of the two settings flows performs better - hypothesis, one primary metric, sample size and significance.
cases.reason: A measured experiment is ab-test-designer's scope; this skill's A/B names journey options, not randomized assignment.

cases.prompt: Run the ship/no-ship readiness gate for next week's release: is the deploy ready and what evidence is missing?
cases.reason: Ship/deploy readiness is release-readiness-reviewer's gate; this skill's readiness is design-progress readiness.
